verdict.rationale: Veriff supports autonomous background automation via webhooks (session/event/decision webhooks that fire without polling) and a no-code Zapier integration explicitly built to 'automate workflows based on end-user verification decisions,' which lets non-developers set up background automations triggered by verification outcomes. However, there is no evidence of AI-agent-specific tooling, scheduled/triggered agent workflows, or an AI-native automation framework beyond generic webhooks/Zapier. Missing for 10: dedicated AI-agent orchestration hooks, evidence of autonomous multi-step agent workflows, and independent corroboration of the Zapier integration's real-world use.
